# DmaUnmap

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Removes a DMA mapping and releases its hold on the memory.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0B` SVC_MANAGEMEMORY | `MNGMEM_DMAUNMAP (5)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err DmaUnmap(Handle dev, uint32_t id);
```

**Registers:** `(dev, id) -> r0 status`

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dev` | in | Device handle with PERM_MAP. |
| `id` | in | Mapping id from DmaMap(). |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_NOENT`](../errors.md#err_noent) | No mapping with that id. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `dev` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `dev` is not a device. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `dev` lacks PERM_MAP. |
